Each nonparent result must have zero per-box-type selected threshold flips and zero all256 oracle mismatches. It does not rerun GPU inference or introduce a GT-dependent inference choice.

checks.detail: Both paths order candidates parent,native initial,native terminal,fused initial,fused terminal and maximize native rec_hits50, then protected-parent flag, then rec_hits25. checks.detail: Protected parent SHA and real step3723 are checked. New candidates require actual spec/provenance/reset/history, full tensor shape/dtype/name identity and strict head load. Initial is real step0 with hidden8 equal parent/output2 zero/empty state. Terminal is3723 with hidden14892/output3723/29778 unique rows/10 optimizer states at3723, plus actual checkpoint and training-log SHA checks.

checks.name: New-winner full model and AdamW witness before old-parent retirement
checks.detail: Actual selected-restore record must be terminal-audit-bound and tied to summary, arm/stage and step. Remote checks its checkpoint digest against the candidate, complete-model equality, exact optimizer witness and direct-factory old-geometry independence. The retention script itself performs CPU head restoration plus optimizer count/step metadata checks, not another full-model/AdamW restore.

checks.name: Explicit future audit contract without historical reuse
checks.detail: The required future contract is TERMINAL_SOURCE_AND_ACTUAL_ARTIFACTS, fresh_context, PASS/WARN with zero blockers, received review call, and relative-path actual_file_digests entries containing sha256 for SUMMARY and, for a new winner, selected restore. Existing old audit examples use other scopes/schemas and are not accepted as this round evidence. No compatibility branch or future audit was fabricated.

checks.name: Retained dependencies and truthful receipt
checks.detail: Exactly four nonwinner paths in the five-candidate set are removed only after validation. Winner file/digest and originalG digest are checked after the loop. Logs/NPZ/PV/G/V99 paths are not deleted and no negative archive is created. Five-before/one-after numbers are scoped to this declared candidate set.

checks.detail: Local source gate precedes SSH; pinned canonical env is checked, reviewed single script is exclusive-uploaded/read-back-compared, and actual receipt is compared before local write. Environment credential is only used for authentication, not printed or archived. Both final files pass Python3.7 grammar AST and in-memory compile under local3.12.6; shlex.join is local-only.
